title: Interior PM Controller
text: Torque-based, field-oriented controller for an internal permanent magnet synchronous motor, 7 inputs, 3 outputs, {Parameterize losses by} sets Select type Single efficiency; {Control Type} selects control Speed, {Stator resistance, Rs} sets the resistance, {D-axis inductance, Ld} sets the inductance 1.7e-3, {Q-axis inductance, Lq} sets the inductance 3.2e-3, {Permanent magnet flux, lambda_pm} sets the flux, {Number of pole pairs, PolePairs} sets the poles, {Physical inertia, viscous damping, static friction, Mechanical} sets the inertia, damping, friction, {Motor constraint}, {Maximum current, I_max} sets the current, {Maximum torque, T_max} sets the torque, {MTPA table breakpoints, bp} sets the number of breakpoints, {Calculate MTPA Table Data} sets the derive parameters, {Torque Breakpoints, T_mtpa} sets the derived, {D-axis table data, id_mtpa} sets the derived, {Q-axis table data, iq_mtpa} sets the derived, {D, Q, and max current limits, idq_limits} sets the derived, {Bandwidth of the current regulator, EV_current}, {Sample time for the torque control, Tst} sets the time 5e-5, {Calculate Current Regulator Gains} sets the derive parameters, {D-axis proportional gain, Kp_d} sets the derived, {Q-axis proportional gain, Kp_q} sets the derived, {D and Q axis integral gain, Ki} sets the derived, {Bandwidth of the motion controller, EV_motion} sets the bandwidth, {Bandwidth of the state filter, EV_sf}, {Calculate Speed Regulator Gains} sets the derive parameters, {Proportional gain, ba} sets the derived, {Angular gain, Ksa} sets the derived, {Rotational gain, Kisa} sets the derived, {Speed regulation time constant, Ksf} sets the derived, {Inertia compensation, Jcomp} sets the derived, {Viscous damping compensation, Fv} sets the derived, {Static friction, Fs} sets the derived, {Overall inverter efficiency, eff} sets the constant, {Vector of speeds (w) for tabulated loss, w_loss_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Vector of torques (T) for tabulated loss, T_loss_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Corresponding losses, losses_table} sets the table, {Vector of speeds (w) for tabulated efficiency, w_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Vector of torques (T) for tabulated efficiency, T_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints and {Corresponding efficiency, efficiency_table} sets the table. Values come from the instance.
